definition.zh-TW: 買賣設備、放款與收回放款等長期資產相關的現金流量。模板三大活動的第二段，本課的設立費也依教材政策放在這裡。
definition.en: Cash flows from buying and selling equipment, making and collecting loans and other long-term asset activity. The second activity section of the template; under the course policy start-up costs are placed here too.
